About Park FnB

Turn your vacant plot into a parking income.

ParkFnB is a parking marketplace. Drivers find, book and pay for a space in the ParkFnB app; owners list their land and earn from every booking. We bring the equipment, the customers and the operations — you keep your plot and receive a monthly share of the revenue.

Add-on 1

Smart QR barrier

A low hoop on every car stall that stands up to guard it and folds flat only when the booked driver scans its QR code. Unbooked cars cannot take a paid stall — no attendant needed.

Add-on 2

CCTV with edge AI

A small ParkFnB computer on site reads the cameras once a second and reports which stalls are free, anything blocking a stall, and security events — without sending video off site.

Key features

Digital payments

Drivers book and pay by UPI in the app. No cash on site.

CCTV & security

AI on the site's cameras flags occupancy, obstructions and intrusions.

Entry & exit management

Each car stall has a QR-locked barrier; only the paying driver can open it.

Monthly parking passes

Hourly, daily and monthly options for offices and residents.

Clean, maintained site

Stalls cleared, marked and kept tidy by ParkFnB.

Revenue tracking

Every booking and rupee visible to you in the owner app, with a monthly statement.

Signage & infrastructure

Stall numbers, QR plates and entry signboards, supplied by ParkFnB.

Run remotely

No staff on site: barriers, cameras and support are run by ParkFnB's team.

How drivers use it

  1. 1Find

    See your plot's free stalls live in the ParkFnB app

  2. 2Book & pay

    Pick a time and pay by UPI in two taps

  3. 3Scan & park

    Scan the stall's QR; the barrier folds flat

  4. 4Leave

    End parking in the app; the stall locks behind them

Commercial model & landowner benefits

About ₹8,100 a month to you, with no investment.

The plot is projected to collect about ₹31,700 a month at 40% occupancy, the planning case. You receive 30% of the net revenue (after GST) every month — about ₹97,000 a year.

How you get paid

  1. 1Driver pays

    Every booking is paid online to ParkFnB

  2. 2GST set aside

    18% GST inside the price is paid to the government

  3. 330% is yours

    Of the net revenue, for every booking on your plot

  4. 4Monthly payout

    Transferred with a statement; live figures in the owner app

What you gain

Recurring income

A monthly payout from land that earns nothing today.

Zero investment

Every rupee of equipment and set-up is ParkFnB's.

Zero hassle

No staff to hire, no cash to handle, no customers to manage.

Full visibility

ParkFnB pays for everything. You pay ₹0.

No attendant in the pilot: barriers, cameras and the app run the site, and ParkFnB's team handles support remotely.

Partnership terms

Tenure

A 1-month pilot, extended to 3 months if month 1 goes well; a longer agreement after that if both sides agree.

Revenue

30% of net revenue to you, paid monthly with a statement.

ParkFnB does

Equipment, set-up, pricing, bookings, payments, support and maintenance.

You provide

Access to the plot and a consent letter for any local approvals.

Exit

Either side can end it with the notice period in the agreement; ParkFnB removes its equipment and returns the plot as found.
